releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6

## Shared profiles and extra touch buttons

- Set global touch/LCD defaults and create named profiles from **Settings →
  Profiles / Global defaults**. Link individual games or assign a profile to
  several prepared games. Edit a shared profile once; linked games use it on
  their next launch.
- Keep per-game exceptions, inspect which profile supplies each setting, and
  reset individual overrides. Existing game settings stay unchanged on upgrade;
  explicitly reset their touch/LCD overrides to adopt shared settings.

  Choose a key and label, size, opacity and separate portrait/landscape positions.
  Additional buttons are included in shared profiles.
- Library backups carry profile definitions and assignments. Phone backups carry
  portable per-game definitions. Restore preserves destination profiles when

releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

releases.body:
**Fixed: the Whirlwind Maze's green wave stopped halfway and restarted at 60 or 120 FPS (#69)**

1.1.38 fixed the timing of the wind gusts, but the green wave you watch to time your run was still wrong. It sweeps across the screen while the game counts frames, then jumps back to start again. At 60 FPS the count ran twice as fast while the wave moved at its normal speed, so it only got halfway across before it restarted, and the jump back was cut short too (at 120 FPS it was worse). With the wave out of step, you couldn't tell when it was safe to run.

The wave now sweeps the whole screen at every frame rate, with the same timing as at Original. Only the wave in the Whirlwind Maze's two wind-wall screens changes.

![The green wave crossing the screen at 60 FPS, right to left](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/main/docs/release-images/1.1.40-whirlwind-wave.jpg)

**What was tested:** on an AYN Thor in the second wind-wall screen, using the reporter's save. At 60 FPS the wave crosses the whole screen in about 1.5 seconds per sweep, the same as at Original. Running through at 60 FPS wasn't tried all the way to the exit.

### Updating

**Frame-rate mods now work: you no longer need to turn off 60/30 FPS Gameplay (#70, #63)**

FF7Recomp adds the in-between animation frames itself at 60 and 120 FPS. Frame-rate mods such as **60/30 FPS Gameplay** and **60 FPS Animations for ChaOS** ship animations that already have those frames, so with one of them on, every animation got its in-between frames twice. Characters moved at half speed, and in story scenes the game showed the wrong poses. That's how a scene could replay part of itself and then stop (#70). Until now the advice was to turn the mod off (#63).

**What changed:**
- When the game starts, it compares each mod animation with the file it replaces. If the mod's copy is that file with its frames doubled or quadrupled, it is left out and the game adds the frames once, at whatever frame rate you play. This goes by the files themselves, not mod names, so other frame-rate animation packs are covered too. The rest of such a mod (its field fixes and options) still applies.

releases.name: v1.1.38
releases.body:
**Fixed: the Whirlwind Maze's green wind walls could not be passed at 60 or 120 FPS (#69)**

The three wind walls in the Whirlwind Maze blow in gusts with a calm gap that you run through. The game times those gusts with a one-frame pause that the 60 and 120 FPS modes did not stretch, so the gusts came 2 to 4 times as fast and the calm gap was much shorter than at 30 FPS. On the last wall the gap was about 1 second at 60 FPS and half a second at 120, so the wall closed on Cloud halfway through.

The wind walls now keep the same timing as at 30 FPS at every frame rate: wait for the wind to die down, then run. Nothing else in the game changes.

![The Whirlwind Maze's second wind wall at 60 FPS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/main/docs/release-images/1.1.38-whirlwind-maze.jpg)

Tested on an AYN Thor at 60 FPS on the second wind wall. The gust timing of all three walls was checked against the game's own field scripts at 30, 60 and 120 FPS.

### Updating
Go to **Settings → Updates** in the launcher (or install this APK over your current version), then press **Play**. It asks to **Update the game** once (a few seconds).

releases.body:
**Side by side: panels on either side, and hide them when you want**

Two additions to the **Side by side (wide screens)** layout from 1.1.35:

- **Left or right:** **Settings → Screen → Side by side: panels on the left** puts the panels at the game's left. By default they stay on the right.
- **Hide and show:** the small **›** / **‹** button at the top of the panels, on the edge next to the game, hides them. The game then uses the whole screen. A small tab at that screen edge brings the panels back. The game keeps running either way, and your choice is remembered the next time you play.

**Panels on the left:**

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

## New

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

releases.name: Winlator CMOD 11.2 Fix 3 - Flyme/Android 16 反孤儿 Subreaper 根治、手柄修复与开始菜单汉化
releases.body:
## 核心变更

### 1. Flyme 12.6 / Android 16 反孤儿进程根治（`libsubreaper.so`）
- 经魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）控制变量实测，系统会在 `< 100ms` 内静默终止普通应用 UID 下托孤给 `init`（`PPID=1`）的孤儿进程。
- 内置 368 字节纯静态 PIE（`ET_DYN`、64KB 对齐）AArch64 启动器 `lib/arm64-v8a/libsubreaper.so`，通过 `prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1)` 接管整个 Wine 进程子树并循环 `wait4(-1)` 回收已退出子进程（含 `-EINTR` 重试，兼容暂停/恢复）。
- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

本版本为首个可在魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）上进入容器的早期修复与中文化版本。

### 实际包含的改动
- **Flyme 12.6 反孤儿进程早期变通方案**：在 `ProcessHelper` 中加入 `prelaunchWineserverIfNeeded()`（前台拉起 `wineserver -f -p`）以及针对 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地双 `fork()` 绕过补丁。
- **服务与窗口调整**：在 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中放行 `PlugPlay` / `RpcSs`，并修改 `Window.disableAllDescendants()` 避免窗口切换后子窗口持续禁用。
- **中文化与中文字体**：完成主要 Android 界面中文化（`values-zh-rCN` / `values-zh` 与主要 Compose 文案），并在容器模板注入文泉驿微米黑字体与 `FontLink` 注册表配置。

### 勘误与已知限制
- **原发布说明更正**：旧说明中关于“16KB 页表兼容 / Android 16 Bionic FORTIFY `open64`/`fcntl64` 崩溃修复”及“对 `explorer.exe` 实施 5 处指令级免疫补丁”的描述与实际打包产物不符——经后续真机复核，实测机型为标准 4KB 页（`PAGE_SIZE=4096`），APK 内的 `wineserver` 与 `explorer.exe` 均未包含上述二进制补丁。
- **已知问题（已在 `fix3` 中解决）**：
  1. 仅对 `proton-9.0-arm64ec` 有效，其他 Wine/Proton 版本无法进入容器；
  2. `wineboot.exe` 退出后 `services.exe` / `winedevice.exe` 仍会因托孤给 PID 1 被 Flyme 击杀，导致虚拟手柄与实体手柄无响应；
  3. 精简/正常模式下 `winebus` / `winehid` 仍为禁用状态（`Start=4`）；
  4. 游戏库快捷方式路径解析存在崩溃缺陷（已在 `fix2` / `fix3` 修复）。

en-nagakiro-winlator-cmod-zh.latest_body:
## 核心变更

### 1. Flyme 12.6 / Android 16 反孤儿进程根治（`libsubreaper.so`）
- 经魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）控制变量实测，系统会在 `< 100ms` 内静默终止普通应用 UID 下托孤给 `init`（`PPID=1`）的孤儿进程。
- 内置 368 字节纯静态 PIE（`ET_DYN`、64KB 对齐）AArch64 启动器 `lib/arm64-v8a/libsubreaper.so`，通过 `prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1)` 接管整个 Wine 进程子树并循环 `wait4(-1)` 回收已退出子进程（含 `-EINTR` 重试，兼容暂停/恢复）。
- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

releases.name: msr2ds 2.2.0
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.1.0

Stereoscopic 3D, nothing missing in wide views anymore, and a log for every play session.

- **Stereoscopic 3D** (#17). Side by side, for 3D TVs, Acer SpatialLabs displays and VR headsets. The game draws both eyes itself, as on a 3DS. On the Display tab: **Stereoscopic 3D** (side by side at half width or at full width), **3D depth** (the 3DS's 3D slider, 10-100%) and **Swap eyes**. It needs the Vulkan renderer.
- **Nothing missing in wide views.** In 16:9 and ultrawide, some breakable blocks and pieces of rock were not drawn. The game draws at most 300 level pieces at a time, and a wider view holds more than that. Now every piece in view is drawn.
- **The game's message boxes keep their shape.** "Save your progress?", "Use the Teleport Station?" and the other boxes the game shows over play no longer stretch in 16:9 and ultrawide.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.1.0
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.9

A fix for the Android phones that crashed at the title screen in 2.0.9, and a pause screen redone for controllers and wide screens.

- **Android: no more crash at the title screen on Adreno 830 phones** (#58, #37). On Snapdragon 8 Elite devices (the Odin 3 and phones with the same chip), 2.0.9 crashed at the first 3D scene: the graphics driver's shader compiler crashed building 2.0.9's new per-material lighting. On Adreno GPUs, lighting now works as it did in 2.0.8, and the lighting code is back in the shape their compiler handled. Other GPUs keep 2.0.9's faster lighting. If 2.0.9 left the app in its safe graphics mode after a crash, this update clears it.
- **The pause screen fills the window**, now on by default (HUD tab: **Fit the pause screen to the window**). Its bars and background reach the window's edges, its buttons and text keep their shape, and the map fills the width, so you see more of the area.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.0.9
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.8

Mostly Android fixes, and faster lighting everywhere.

- **Android: "Not built yet" with the native code in place** (#58, #63). On some devices (an Odin 3 in #58), Android gives a `recomp-android` folder copied in from a PC an owner the app can't read. The app now makes the `recomp-android` folder itself, so a copy from the PC goes into a folder it owns. If a folder you copied in earlier can't be read, the launcher says so and what to do: delete that folder from the PC, then copy the two files from the PC's `recomp-android` folder (`libmsr_aot.so` and `module.json`) into the empty one the app makes in its place. A copy dropped inside the app's folder (`recomp-android/recomp-android`) is moved up. `launcher.log` says what the launcher found.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.0.8
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.7

- **New menus.** The settings menu (F1 or Select) and the launcher have a new look: a dark glass panel, a tab strip you switch with LB and RB, and on/off switches in place of checkboxes. Every option is where it was. The **Controls** tab is now one page that scrolls as a whole, with headings. Before, its bindings scrolled in a box two rows tall.
- **Quick save and Quick load on a controller.** Hold **Back** and press **LB** to quick save, or **Back + RB** to quick load. F5 and F8 still work. To use other buttons, choose the button beside Quick save or Quick load (Game tab or Controls tab), then hold the buttons you want until its 5-second count ends. A combo needs two buttons or more, and the triggers count. Because Back is in these combos, Back on its own now opens the menu when you let go of it, not when you press it.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.0.7
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.6

Several of these come from comparing the game's renderer with Azahar's (the emulator our 1.x releases were built on), which has years of fixes for phone graphics drivers.

- **Android: phones with Mali graphics** (#52, #54: Unisoc T820, Helio G99 and others), where the screen stayed black while the game played on. Mali's driver sometimes ends a wait for the GPU early with an error. The game ignored that and reused memory the GPU was still drawing with. It now waits again, as Azahar does. It also no longer stalls for good when the next frame's image can't be had, and on Mali it sets the depth and stencil state the way Azahar does there. This hasn't been confirmed on a Mali device yet: please try it and attach `msr-native.log` to #52, whether it works or not.

releases.name: Pokemon Legends Arceus V1.2
releases.body:
## Arceus Recomp for Android – Update

### Highlights
- **Game code is now built on your phone.** The APK no longer ships any game code. After you pick your own `prod.keys`, game (`.nsp`/`.xci`) and update in **Game Files**, the app translates and compiles `libgame.so` on the device using a bundled Python, translator, clang and lld. It takes about 10 minutes on an Odin 3, and if it's interrupted it picks up where it left off. When it finishes, **Play** appears and you can delete the game files from your phone.
- **Music and voices work.** The Switch's Opus decoder service (hwopus) is now implemented with libopus 1.5.2.

### Better support for other phones
- **Automatic performance profiles.** On first start the app picks a profile from your GPU (Adreno, Mali/Immortalis, Xclipse, PowerVR) and your RAM. You can change it under *Video > Android > Performance profile*.
  - **High:** 100% resolution, 60 fps (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and newer).
  - **Medium:** dynamic resolution (never below 60%), 60 fps.
  - **Light:** 75% resolution, 30 fps, half-size shadows.

- **Much less heat:** CPU went from ~84 °C to ~52 °C and the fan is barely audible.
- **CPU cores:** the game uses 4 cores and leaves the rest free. You can pick All / 4 / 2.
- **Clock speeds:** the port tells Android how long each frame really takes, on the CPU and the GPU. The CPU no longer sits at max clock, and the GPU clocks up when it needs to.
- **Less data copying:** GPU constants are read straight from shared memory, so about 80% less data is copied per frame.
- **Pause in the background:** the game pauses when you leave the app.

### Graphics
- **Vulkan on Adreno**, with support for the **Turnip** (Mesa) driver, which you can import and pick from the menu.
- **"Soft" anti-aliasing** (new, default): blends the dithered pattern on hair, leaves and grass at no fps cost. SMAA is also available.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.6.0
releases.body:
This one is mostly about what happens *under* the 3D. The emulator itself got a lot better.

## New

**Accuracy: 147 of 147 on AccuracyCoin.** 0.5.0 passed 128. Zaxnes was also compared cycle by cycle with a transistor-level simulation of the NES chips (421,901 CPU cycles, DMA included), and the timing matched. Where the two still differ, tests made on real consoles side with Zaxnes.

**Over 400 mappers.** Up from 144. That includes the **Famicom Disk System**, the **VS. System** with its cabinet buttons, and newer boards like the Rainbow.

**A fast core.** It skips work the screen doesn't need, but gives the same results as the accurate core. We checked that frame by frame on 320 ROMs. Handhelds use it by default.

**New options window.** One slider goes from *Fastest* to *Most faithful* and sets everything that costs speed. A simple mode shows only what most people need, and an advanced mode shows everything. It works the same on the PC and on the console screen.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.5.0
releases.body:
Zaxnes is an independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo.

## Highlights

**3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 compatibility.** Profiles from 3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 import and play, with what the new versions brought: reflections, bend, the new camera and Lua features.

**A real NES emulator, not just a gimmick.** Mapper support goes from 85 to 144, and AccuracyCoin from 89 to 128 tests out of 147. More accuracy work is coming in the next releases.

**New widescreen hacks: Kirby's Adventure and Faxanadu.** Every regional version of each. Faxanadu already has its 3D profile in this release; Kirby's is on the way.

**Smooth scrolling at 120 Hz (experimental).** On a 120 Hz screen, the playfield is drawn between two emulated frames, from the run-ahead.

**RetroArch shaders.** Slang shaders (through librashader) on the Vulkan / DirectX 12 renderer: CRT, scanlines, LCD, Mega Bezel TV frames. A pack of presets is built in, separately for 2D and 3D. Available on Android too.

**Editor mode for 3D profiles (work in progress).** An AI-assisted editor: it gives an AI agent a harness through a local MCP server, and a prompt ready to copy and paste. Expect more on it in the next release.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.6
releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.
- Fixed: the feature now engages reliably on every launch (previously a first-launch state could
  latch process-wide), the blade reports its live state honestly (including a "restart game" hint

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.21

**Smoother in motion — every game**
- Fixed a per-frame Vulkan memory allocation in the FSR upscaler (the default scaler) that blocked the render thread on GPU fences hundreds of times per second under load. Heavy titles no longer dip as hard when the camera moves — every game running the FSR scaler benefits.

**New — console features**
- **Console Mode**: choose Docked or Handheld globally *and* per game, with a live mode tag in the overlay. Your per-game choice always outranks the built-in recommendation.

- **Closing from Steam now exits cleanly in seconds** (was an 8-second hang + force-kill, every time).

Automated build of `master` at babb633b330c725cd5757de61f3f2dc81ce4fa25.

These are untested snapshots and may be broken. For stable builds use the [latest release](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/releases/latest).

**GUIs** (`super-snes9x-nightly-*`): Windows: unzip and run. Linux: `chmod +x` the AppImage. macOS: the app is universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) and self-signed, so after copying it run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine super-snes9x-qt.app`.

**libretro cores** (`supersnes9x_libretro-nightly-*`): unzip the core and its `.info` file into RetroArch's cores directory. The macOS core is a universal x86_64 + arm64 binary.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

## Voicer-kun

- Убраны тормоза беты 5: без лимита кадры опять «не чаще 60» (в бете 5 игра пыталась рисовать до 120 кадров на 120-Гц экране и перегружала видеокарту).

- Убраны кнопки, которые ничего не меняли: ручной выбор частоты экрана и дубль лимита FPS в «Графике». Лимит — в «☰ ▸ FPS».

**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 5 (ветка v12.7)**

releases.name: Version 5.10.2
releases.body:
Changes:

- Fix authentication for registries without token service: Nexus, Artifactory and htpasswd-protected servers.
- Report bad `PD_DOCKER_AUTH` credentials before initiating install or push session.

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2 is here!!!

This release focuses on smoother high-resolution Vulkan performance, audio and graphics fixes reported by the community, and quality-of-life improvements for libraries, saves, and RetroAchievements. --- ## Vulkan performance improvements Vulkan has received major performance and stability improvements in this release. Repeated calculations and redundant reads were reduced, and rendering work is now grouped more efficiently. These improvements benefit different internal resolutions and are not exclusive to a single chipset or device family. Tested results include: | Device / SoC | Internal Resolution | Result in tested sections | |---|---:|---| | T820 | **6x** | Close to **60 FPS** in the tested sections of Spirit Tracks, Phantom Hourglass, and Dragon Ball Origins. This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options.

This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name.

The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases.

However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible.

For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

## Type your own name

Until now a new game was always named "Flip", because the console's on-screen keyboard did nothing in the port. Now, when you start a new game, a text box with Android's keyboard asks for your name:

Nothing else changes: graphics, frame rate and shader caches are the same as in 1.4.0.
